===Objectives===
*Find and kill the [[Bandit Ringleader]]s inside [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]]. [6...0] remain.
*See [[Lieutenant Langmar]] for your reward.

*1,000 [[Experience]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lieutenant Langmar
:''"These bandit raids are getting ridiculous!  Frankly, I don't care if their motives are greed, politics, or anything else, I just want them gone and out of our hair!  I'm fairly sure if we take out their leaders, the rest will either flee or be too disorganized to pose a serious threat.  If you are up to the task, go to Regent Valley and Kill all of the Bandit Ringleaders.  That should let the rest of them know we aren't going to stand for this any longer!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Consider it done!
| decline = You can silence your own dissenters!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Lieutenant Langmar
:''"You have done well!  I fear this isn't the end of the bandits in the area, but it has certainly dealt them a blow!"''

==Notes==
*The locations pointed out on the map are approximate. The Ringleaders may spawn more than [[Range#Compass_and_party_range|compass range]] away from each of the 6 locations.
*This quest can be done very quickly by some professions (mesmer for instance) by focusing only on Bandit Ringleaders and moving between groups under the effects of a [[Birthday Cupcake]].
*The bandits spawned by this quest are hostile to [[Mary Malone]] and [[Ivor Trueshot]], and will occasionally spawn close enough to aggro and kill them.
{{bug|When one bandit leader remains, the quest text erroneously ends with ''1 remain.''}}
